title: Single-molecule analysis reveals low-temperature misfolding in HIV-1 TAR RNA

comments: Integrating single-molecule force spectroscopy with computational landscape analysis provides mechanistic insight into non-standard RNA folding regimes often overlooked in bulk studies.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Low temperature (<20°C) shifts RNA folding equilibrium toward native state

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bulge motif promotes distinct misfolded intermediates at low temperature

hypotheses.hypothesis: Loop rather than bulge architecture drives low-temperature effects
hypotheses.result: Rejected; bulge, not loop, is the primary structural determinant
